subject: Discount/credit exception request (Pricing Experiment Variant B) — ZenChat
body:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Mendes <sofia@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris.osei@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 8:14 AM PST
Subject: Discount/credit exception request (Pricing Experiment Variant B) — ZenChat
Attachments: ZenChat_Discount_Request_Summary.pdf

Laura / team — requesting expedited approval for a one-off discount/credit exception for ZenChat due to procurement timing + our Q1 pricing experiment window.

Context:
- Account: ZenChat (Enterprise, procurement stage)
- Product: Hosted API + Dedicated (small pool) bundle
- Current state: they are in the Variant B pricing cohort (experiment flag already applied). They’re asking for a concession to sign by Feb 14.
- Risk: if we don’t respond this weekend, they push to March (outside this quarter’s forecast + experiment calendar).

Ask:
1) Approve either:
   A) One-time service credit of $50k applied against usage (expires 90 days), OR
   B) 12% discount on Hosted API rates for 6 months (then revert to standard rates)
2) Confirm any required language for usage definition / credits so Legal can keep the order form clean.

My recommendation is option A (credit), to avoid muddying rate cards mid-experiment.

Key numbers (high level):
- Expected first 90 days usage: ~$140–$170k (mix: ~65% chat, 25% embeddings, 10% rerank)
- Dedicated add-on: $28k/mo commit
- If we do (A), effective concession ~25–35% of first 90 days Hosted API, but contained/expiring

If approved, I’ll communicate to Priya (procurement) and keep the cohort tagging intact for analysis.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference


---
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Mendes <sofia@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris.osei@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 8:42 AM PST
Subject: Re: Discount/credit exception request (Pricing Experiment Variant B) — ZenChat

Jordan — a few gating questions before we sign off:

1) Is ZenChat already under a signed MSA, or is this net-new MSA + OF? (matters for credit/dispute language)
2) Is the $50k credit “service credit” (non-refundable, non-cash) and only for Hosted API usage (not Dedicated commit)?
3) Any other concessions (payment terms, SLA, data retention) bundled in?
4) We need to preserve experiment integrity. Chris: can we tag this as a discount exception so it doesn’t contaminate Variant B readout?

Leaning toward a credit if it’s tightly scoped + expiring. Please confirm the above.

Laura Bennett
CFO
Redwood Inference


---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Mendes <sofia@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris.osei@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 9:06 AM PST
Subject: Re: Discount/credit exception request (Pricing Experiment Variant B) — ZenChat
Attachments: ZenChat_Order_Form_Draft_v2_redlines.docx

Thanks — answers inline:

1) Net-new MSA + Order Form. ZenChat is pushing a few usage-definition clarifications (retries + caching) — see redlines attached.
2) Yes: service credit, non-refundable, non-transferable, applies only to Hosted API usage charges. Does NOT offset Dedicated monthly commit.
3) No other concessions requested. Payment terms standard Net 30. No SLA exceptions. Security/retention: they asked for confirmation of audit logs + retention policy; we’re pointing them to standard docs (no custom).
4) Agree on tagging. Chris — if we need an explicit flag, we can add an internal “discount_exception=true” note in HubSpot and ensure Finance can see it.

If we can approve $50k credit with 90-day expiration, I can send revised OF language today.

Jordan


---
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Mendes <sofia@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris.osei@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 10:01 AM PST
Subject: Re: Discount/credit exception request (Pricing Experiment Variant B) — ZenChat

Legal POV:

- Credit is workable, but we need to use the approved “Service Credits” clause language (non-refundable; no cash value; applied against invoices for Usage Charges; expires on a date certain; unused credits are forfeited).
- Important: ZenChat’s redline tries to exclude “retry requests” from billable usage broadly. We cannot accept that phrasing as written.
  - We can clarify: we do not intentionally double-charge server-side retries/fallback for the same request_id/idempotency key, and we’ll reference the Usage API as the source for reported usage.
  - But we should not commit to “no charges for any retries” (client retries can legitimately create additional usage).
- Caching: acceptable to state that cached tokens may be billed at a reduced rate (or not billed depending on the plan), but we should avoid hard commitments on internal implementation. We can align to the “billed tokens vs raw tokens” definition.

Sofia — can you provide the updated OF rider language for credits + usage definition references? Jordan — if you want to send an email to procurement today, keep it high-level and avoid implementation details.

Michael Grant
General Counsel
Redwood Inference


---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Mendes <sofia@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris.osei@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 10:24 AM PST
Subject: Re: Discount/credit exception request (Pricing Experiment Variant B) — ZenChat

Adding Finance/FP&A view:

- Preference is credit over rate discount (keeps the experiment pricing clean + avoids “anchoring” a lower rate in future renewals).
- $50k is above the self-serve threshold but within enterprise exception range if we (a) keep it usage-only, (b) 90-day expiry, and (c) document as a one-time concession tied to procurement timing.
- For margin model, we should tag the credit separately from pricing changes. Chris: please ensure it’s excluded from Variant B conversion/ARPU comparisons or at least segmented.

Laura — if you approve, I’ll note this as “one-time usage credit” for revrec tracking.

Rishi


---
From: Sofia Mendes <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris.osei@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 11:11 AM PST
Subject: Re: Discount/credit exception request (Pricing Experiment Variant B) — ZenChat

Jordan — I can turn a clean edit quickly. Proposed approach:

1) Order Form: add “Service Credits” line item:
- Amount: $50,000
- Applies to: Hosted API Usage Charges only
- Expiration: 90 days from Effective Date
- Non-refundable, non-transferable; no cash value

2) Usage definition: incorporate the standard language from the playbook:
- Usage is based on Redwood’s metering and reported in the Usage API/Console
- Retries: only de-dupe for the same idempotency key / request_id (no blanket exclusion)
- Caching: billed tokens may differ from raw tokens; credits apply to billed usage

If you confirm effective date target (Feb 14?) I’ll mark the expiry accordingly.

Sofia
Sofia Mendes
Commercial Counsel
Redwood Inference


---
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Mendes <sofia@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris.osei@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 8, 2026 at 4:41 PM PST
Subject: Re: Discount/credit exception request (Pricing Experiment Variant B) — ZenChat

Approved with conditions:

- Approve $50,000 one-time service credit (usage-only), 90-day expiry from Effective Date.
- Must not apply to Dedicated commit or any minimums.
- Use Sofia’s standard clause language; do not accept ZenChat’s broad “retry exclusion” redline.
- Chris: ensure we tag this as a discount/credit exception in HubSpot + exclude/segment from Variant B readout.

Jordan — OK to communicate to ZenChat procurement that we can do a one-time service credit to help with ramp timing, subject to final paper.

Laura
